SELECT template_id , template_name , description , thumbnail_url , CASE WHEN position('r-aside' IN html_content) = 0 THEN 'single' WHEN position('r-aside' IN html_content) < position('r-main' IN html_content) THEN 'sidebar' ELSE 'split' END AS layout_type , substring(css_content FROM '--primary\s*:\s*(#[0-9A-Fa-f]{3,8})') AS primary_color , css_content ~* '\.r-header\s*\{[^}]*background\s*:' AS has_banner , is_public , created_by , use_yn , created_at , updated_at FROM templates WHERE use_yn = 'Y'
AND is_public = true
AND ( is_public = true OR created_by = #{userId} )
ORDER BY is_public DESC NULLS LAST, template_id ASC

SELECT template_id , template_name , description , thumbnail_url , html_content , css_content , is_public , created_by , use_yn , created_at , updated_at FROM templates WHERE template_id = #{templateId}
